title: Glass Shelf With Towel Bar 16-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Need more bathroom storage without giving up counter space? This wall-mounted glass shelf adds an easy spot for daily essentials and includes an integrated towel bar for grab-and-go convenience.

Highlights:
- Keep toiletries organized at the vanity with a 16 x 5 Inch shelf surface
- Enjoy durable, safer glass with 3/8-Inch thick tempered, beveled-edge glass
- Add towel storage below with the integrated towel bar design
- Count on enduring hardware with solid brass construction
- Coordinate your bathroom with the Waverly Place Collection for a matching Waverly Place look

Specs & Installation:
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Glass size: 16 x 5 Inches
- Overall projection: 5 Inches
- Glass thickness: 0.38 Inch (3/8 Inch)
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available
